fact: The Centre hospitalier universitaire de Libreville launched doctoViene, a platform built by the firm Viene for online birth declaration with certificates stored in an electronic database, in June 2024.
UNICEF's deputy representative says about 96% of children in Gabon are registered at birth, a national rate not tied to a digital system.
The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) finances developing a fully digitalised civil registry system and digitising legacy paper civil registry records.
